Uses of Package
jsesh.mdc.interfaces

Packages that use jsesh.mdc.interfaces
jsesh.mdc This package contains code for reading texts written in the Manuel de Codage format.  
jsesh.mdc.interfaces This package contain a number of interfaces, which are used as markers in combination with the MDCModelBuilder interface and the parser, to generate a model from a MDC text.  
jsesh.mdc.model A usable model for representing a Manuel de Codage file.  
jsesh.mdc.parser   
jsesh.simpleDemo A simple demonstration for the use of the Manuel de codage analyser, BZR reader, etc...
